Independently re-evaluated signed chain traces for all 24×2 automorphisms and obtained H1 cycle-type values (6,0,-2,0,0) for S4 without hub exchange and exact negatives with exchange, orientation class sign(S4) independent of exchange. Scope is unordered 3 particles only.
